entities.summary: The Wilanów Mosque is a Sunni Islamic mosque in Warsaw, Poland, located within the Wilanów district. It is placed at 103 Wiertnicza Street, in the neighbourhood of Wilanów Niski. It is operated by the Islamic Cultural Centre, and is part of the Muslim Religious Association. The building was opened in 1993.
